title: Stout Chocolate Cake
steps: Preheat oven to 160°C and grease three 8-inch cake tins.
Whisk flour, cocoa, salt, baking soda, and baking powder.
Mix stout, vanilla, and espresso powder in a cup.
Cream 260g butter and 300g sugar, beat in eggs and mayo.
Alternate adding dry and wet mixes, fold in chocolate.
Bake 35 mins, cool, frost with buttercream, and serve.
